description: This Java source file defines a Fragment class named LogFragment that manages a view displaying logs through a custom LogView. It handles view creation, layout setup, and updates to the log display within an Android application.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that contains a custom log view (LogView). It provides methods for initializing the view, handling text updates, and exposing the LogView instance.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, styles, and padding, then returns the top-level view.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Overrides Fragment's method to set up the view hierarchy and attach a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on log updates.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance contained within the fragment.
